communications.subject: Government Records Access and Management Act Request: Jail Booking Log / Arrest Register (Jan 2025-present)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Government Records Access and Management Act, I hereby request the following records:

Under the Utah Government Records Access and Management Act, Utah Code § 63G-2-201 et seq., I request the following existing record: The daily jail booking log (booking register / arrest blotter) for all individuals booked into your facility from January 1, 2025 through the present. For each booking, I request the fields your booking system already records: (1) name of the individual booked; (2) date and time of booking; (3) the charge(s) and offense level; (4) bond amount and type, and the date any bond was posted; and (5) the date and manner of release from your custody. This is routine booking data maintained in your jail-management system in the ordinary course. I will accept it in whatever native electronic format your system exports (a spreadsheet or delimited file is ideal; I do not require a formatted report). As a public-interest, non-commercial request, I ask for a fee waiver or reduction; if any fee is anticipated, please provide an itemized written estimate before incurring cost. Please preserve all responsive records pending completion.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Glen Wasserstein

communications.subject: Michigan Freedom of Information Act Request: Deed Fraud Unit (ROD)
communications.communication:
Under the Michigan Freedom of Information Act, I request the following existing records maintained by the Wayne County Register of Deeds concerning the Mortgage and Deed Fraud Unit for Jan. 1, 2016 through the date this request is processed:

- Monthly, quarterly and annual statistical reports showing inquiries or complaints received, cases opened, cases referred for investigation, search warrants, arrest warrants, criminal charges, convictions, cases closed and stolen homes or properties returned.
- The existing records used to calculate or substantiate the cumulative figures currently published on the Register of Deeds’ Mortgage and Deed Fraud Unit webpage: 13,013 inquiries, 2,343 cases opened, 1,172 search warrants, 505 arrest warrants, 347 convictions and 393 stolen homes returned.

This includes any existing spreadsheet, database report, running tally, case log or statistical worksheet used to update those figures. Please provide electronic records in their native format with all existing fields and formulas intact. I am not requesting the creation of a new compilation.

- Existing definitions, written methodologies, policies or instructions explaining what the unit counts as an “inquiry,” “case opened,” “search warrant,” “arrest warrant,” “conviction” and “stolen home returned,” including whether multiple defendants or multiple properties within one investigation are counted separately.
- Records showing when the figures on the webpage were most recently updated and the figures that appeared before each update since Jan. 1, 2016.
- Existing reports showing complaints that were declined, closed without investigation or referred to another agency, including the reason categories used for those dispositions.

If a responsive record contains exempt personal or investigative information, please redact that information and produce all reasonably segregable nonexempt portions. If no responsive record exists for an item, please state that. Electronic records should be provided in their native format where available.
